task: story_advance INIT_CHECK persists phase=INIT_CHECK before worktree bootstrap (dev_start) runs; on bootstrap failure no rollback and no INIT_CHECK->INIT back-edge leaves the story stuck (phase advanced, requiresWorktree=true, no worktree, unrecoverable).
outcome: When worktree bootstrap fails, the user sees `⚠ INIT_CHECK aborted: <reason>. Story B-804c stays at INIT.` and `lattice story_get` still shows phase INIT (not INIT_CHECK). For a story already stuck in INIT_CHECK with no worktree, running `lattice dev_start {storyId}` prints `Story B-xxx development environment is ready / Path: .../.worktrees/B-xxx` recreating the worktree, instead of being unrecoverable.
facts: cli-engine.ts INIT_CHECK block: advanceResult=await handlers.story_advance(v.data) writes phase to disk (~line 4040) BEFORE handlers.dev_start({storyId}) bootstraps the worktree (~line 4047).
The catch at ~line 4059-4061 only emits a warning string; it does NOT roll the phase back.
core/machine.ts:503-508 INIT_CHECK state has only PLAN and START(guard canSkipPlan) edges; no INIT_CHECK->INIT back-edge.

handlers/worktree.ts dev_start is ALREADY idempotent: if story.worktree exists+dir exists it returns early; if record stale it clears+recreates; accepts phase INIT_CHECK/PLAN/DEV; on its own internal failures rolls back story.worktree=undefined.
